title: [MR-003] Start, resume and import manual replies through the shared Vibez writer
objective: Advance eligible manual console sessions with native writer coordination and durable bound receipts.
inScope: Authorized start, resume, reply import and receipt recovery over the v1 contract.
Native writer coordination, additive submission correlation, CLI interoperability, compatibility and rollback.
outOfScope: New task admission, unattended execution, browser-granted publication, approval, lock recovery and merge, history UI.
acceptanceCriteria: MR-003.1: Route raw JSON or a single fenced block through the native importer. Keep malformed, multiple-block, wrong-run, wrong-role and stale replies associated with the selected intent. Rejection preserves the selected and sibling pending handoffs.

MR-003.2: Reconcile double-clicks, lost responses, interrupted inbox delivery, host restart and concurrent CLI/UI operations using the shared writer and durable keys. Record one accepted judgment and at most one successor handoff. Reject changed intent under a reused key.

MR-003.3: Authorize start/resume for eligible prepared native sessions. Surface admission, writer and revision blockers. Keep successful import and subsequent gate outcomes distinct. Deny browser publication, approval, lock recovery and merge.
validationPlan: Run all repository checks and real native driver HTTP integration for negative bindings, durable replay, interrupted delivery, CLI watch and writer contention.
Verify command disable/drain and continued CLI inspection and resume without modifying history.
